label: placeholder - draft from published sources, awaiting clinician review
note: Single source of truth for the live narrowing: when the list may be shown, when the flow may stop, and the bands. All numbers are placeholders for the clinician to confirm. Strength is a match score from 0 to 1, NOT a probability, and is never shown as a number.

structureType.note: Constants of the structure-type step that runs before muscle ranking. Placeholders for the clinician to confirm. Strength is a match score, not a probability.

bandsNote: Bands (Low / Moderate / Higher) are shown only after this many answers that are not unknown (movements and questions together). Before that the model highlights the provisional candidates and the strip says 'Still narrowing'.
